title: The Behemoth Trilogy
description:
NoticeThis game was made for educational purposes at The Game Assembly in Malmö, Sweden. The game is completely free and will remain so forever.

Об игреThe Behemoth Trilogy is a collection of games developed over two semesters by Behemoth, a team of 21 students at The Game Assembly in Malmö, Sweden. Every game is powered by LAMP Engine, our fully custom C++/DirectX 11 game engine built from the ground up.

PEAX - Extreme snowboardingBehemoth BIG invites you and the world’s best snowboarders to the most extreme competition on the globe! Grind, trick and boost your way down the slopes as you battle for the grand prize, crowning you the WORLD champion! 

Features Split Screen multiplayer up to four players! 

Want to stand out even more on the slopes? Enter the iconic Konami Code to unlock additional character customization options.

Maruk: Shipwrecked - 3D PlatformerWashed ashore with no rum in hand, deckhand Maruk must woozily dash, jump and traverse across a treacherous archipelago. Strike a bargain with the ghost captain Greedy McNeedy to peer into the World Beyond. Find booty, and hopefully a way home. 

Think you've mastered the islands? Inside the deepest part of the vortex conceals a secret level ready to prove you wrong.

Spite: Ashes of Ephtael - Top down Hack-and-SlashAs Cinder, crusader of the Torch-Bearers, venture into the corrupted swamp, Epthael. ​Blaze a path through the foul creatures of the swamp to reclaim it from Pythos' grasp, as you, and your faith, grow stronger. 

Credits

TechnologiesMade using FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.
Made using PhysX by NVIDIA
description_short: Three games in one trilogy: shred extreme slopes in PEAX, dash around in treacherous islands in Maruk: Shipwrecked, and battle corruption in Spite: Ashes of Ephtael. From high-speed snowboarding to platforming chaos and dark fantasy combat. Three worlds, one collection!
